reading.action: When the cold-bitten bar feels full, pull it from the water and transfer HALF its cold essence into the river-stone (Essence Infusion), then return both to the water. Meanwhile keep the rivet in the fire, feeding fuel as long as the armful lasts, drawing half out whenever it fills.
reading.result: PART A (river-stone transfer) — SOLID-BUT-STRUGGLED (margin 9; roll 2 is near the floor, only his INT 19 carried it). He drew HALF the charged cold-essence out of the cold-bitten bar and bound it into the river-stone. It HOLDS — but roughly: this is an OPPOSITE-pole bind (cold, against his fire-attuned hands), so the POLARITY TAX bit hard on a bad roll — high Focus burn + a shakier-than-usual knot. River-stone is now cold-IMBUED but CRUDE/unstable (a beginner's cross-pole bind that will bleed off unless fed by the water). NO Apprentice demo: the Novice->Apprentice gate needs a CLEAN holding bind without heavy struggle, and roll 2 + tax = heavy struggle -> Essence Infusion STAYS Novice. Small authorship credit for completing a genuine harder cross-pole transfer: score 4 -> 5 (within Novice). Both cold objects (bar + new imbued stone) returned to the water to soak. COST: Focus -22 (taxed + struggled). | PART C (rivet farm) — DETERMINISTIC MONTAGE, anti-farm. He runs the charge/half-draw loop on the rivet (resonant/same-element = comes home cheap), feeding the brazier from the armful. The lesson lands in the body: the fire is a THIN source and his body SATURATES — the first pull or two deepen his Ember for real, then it PLATEAUS, giving nothing more no matter how many times he pulls. The armful burns down and the loop winds itself out (his own 'as long as there is fuel' bound it). COST: HP -3 (repeated integration sears), Focus -3 (control). Stamina recovers 6 -> 18 (long seated rest tending the fire). Armful now running low. | AFFINITY — Ember Manipulation counter 1 -> 3 (+2). Applies the recommended per-point ramp (points 1-10 = 1 event each) PROVISIONALLY (Alan's schedule pick still open, adjustable): +1 = the turn-33 deliberate half-draw (was HELD pending the ramp, lands now), +1 = this turn's sustained resonant farming (before the plateau). A half-draw counts as a WHOLE qualifying event (graded on authorship/control, not on how much of the source was drained). | NO Tower reset.
